description_en: Queries the sandbox instances under the current account
description_zh: 查看当前账号下的沙箱实例列表
name: DescribeSandboxInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup schedule. You can call the DescribeBackupPlanList (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dbs/2019-03-06/DescribeBackupPlanList) operation to query the ID.
If your instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, you can use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html feature to automatically add the instance to DBS and obtain the backup schedule ID
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID，您可以通过DescribeBackupPlanList (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dbs/2019-03-06/DescribeBackupPlanList)接口获取该参数。
若您的实例为RDS MySQL，请通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html功能，将RDS自动添加至DBS中，即可获取备份计划ID
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the sandbox instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437252.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 沙箱实例ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437252.html接口获取该参数

Data.description_en:
The parameter descriptions:
connectionString: The connection string of the sandbox instance, in the IP:Port format. If SandboxType is Sandbox, this parameter indicates the endpoint of the sandbox instance. If SandboxType is NFS, this parameter indicates the NFS mount address.
restoreSeconds: The time required to create the sandbox instance, in seconds.
restoreTime: The point in time for restoration. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC time).
instanceId: The sandbox instance ID.
backupSetId: The backup set ID.
createTime: The time when the sandbox instance was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC time).
backupPlanId: The backup schedule ID.
vpcId: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID.
vpcSwitchId: The vSwitch ID.
sandboxSpecification: The specifications of the sandbox instance.
status: The sandbox instance status. Valid values: running (running), check_pass (precheck passed), and stop (abnormal)
Data.description_zh:
参数说明：
connectionString：沙箱实例的连接字符串，格式为IP:Port。当SandboxType为Sandbox时，该参数表示沙箱实例的连接地址；当SandboxType为NFS时，该参数表示NFS挂载地址。
restoreSeconds：创建沙箱实例所需的时长，单位为秒。
restoreTime：恢复的时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
instanceId：沙箱实例ID。
backupSetId：备份集ID。
createTime：沙箱实例的创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
backupPlanId：备份计划ID。
vpcId：专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud） ID。
vpcSwitchId：VPC交换机ID。
sandboxSpecification：沙箱实例规格。
status：沙箱实例状态，运行中（running）、预检查通过（check_pass）、异常（stop）
